welcome_sub: Plan trips, share with friends, get there.
terms_note: By continuing you agree to our Terms and Privacy Policy.
not_invited_title: You'll need an invite for this one
not_invited_p1: Traver Planel is in a small private phase right now, so new accounts are opened by invite only. Nothing is wrong with your account or with the link you followed — we just haven't opened the doors to everyone yet.
not_invited_p2: If someone told you to expect access, ask them to add the email address you just tried, then come back and sign in again — it'll work straight away.
not_invited_p3: If you found us from a post and want to try it:
not_invited_p4: Thanks for the interest. We'd rather open up slowly and keep the app good than open up fast and break it.
landing_title: Plan trips, share with friends, get there.
landing_lede: One place for the itinerary, the map, the hotels and what it all costs — instead of six chat threads and a spreadsheet.
landing_invite_note: Invite-only for now. Got an invite link? Open it to join.
landing_alt_desktop: A five-day Tokyo and Mount Fuji trip: the day's stops listed on the left, pinned on a map on the right
landing_alt_phone: The same trip's itinerary on a phone
landing_feat_itinerary_body: Day-by-day plan. Drag places into order, keep notes where you need them.
landing_feat_map_body: Every stop on one map, with real travel times between them.
landing_feat_bookings_body: Stays, transport and expenses in the same place as the plan.
landing_feat_together_body: Invite the people coming with you and edit the trip as a group.
landing_calendar_title: See the whole trip at a glance
landing_calendar_body: Days, stays and flights laid out on a calendar.
landing_calendar_alt: Calendar view of a five-day trip with each day and hotel stay marked
landing_budget_body: Spending by category, per day and per person.
landing_budget_alt: Budget view showing total spent and a breakdown by transport, hotels and food
nav_pending_save_body: Leaving now means you will not see whether this save succeeded. Leave anyway?
err_not_found_body: That trip / page does not exist or you do not have access.
err_trip_body_fallback: Something went wrong while loading this trip. Try again.
auth_err_config_body: An authentication provider isn't set up correctly. Please contact support.
auth_err_denied_body: You declined access. Try again or use a different method.
auth_err_link_expired_body: That magic link has been used or has expired. Request a new one.
auth_err_oauth_title: Couldn't sign in with that provider
auth_err_oauth_body: Something went wrong on the provider's end. Try again, or use a different method.
auth_err_email_body: Email delivery failed. Check the address and try again.
auth_err_rate_limited_body: Give it a few minutes and try again.
auth_err_credentials_body: The credentials don't match an account. Try again.
auth_verify_body: We sent a sign-in link to your inbox. The link expires in 24 hours.
auth_verify_spam_hint: Didn't get it? Check spam, then try again.
invite_not_found_body: The link is invalid or has already been used.
invite_wrong_account_body: This invite was issued to {email}, not the account you're signed in with. Sign out and sign back in with the invited address, or ask the trip owner to send a new invite to the address you actually use.
invite_expired_body: Ask the trip owner for a fresh link.
home_empty_body: Start planning your first trip, or seed the Mt Fuji & Kamakura demo to see what's possible.
trip_delete_confirm_body: “{title}” will be deleted for everyone on it.
trip_new_lede: Start with a destination — we’ll fill in the rest.
trip_new_destination_hint: Pick a suggestion to auto-fill the rest, or just type a name.
trip_new_date_error: End date can’t be before the start date.
err_session_expired_save: Your session expired. Sign in again to save this.
err_forbidden_change: You do not have permission to change this.
itin_day_mode_error_toast: Couldn't change the day's travel mode
itin_day_mode_override_body: Override every segment in this day to "{mode}"? This replaces individual settings.
itin_optimize_body: Reorder this day to save {time} driving
itin_dnd_instructions: To pick up a draggable item, press the space bar. While dragging, use the arrow keys to move the item. Press space again to drop the item in its new position, or press escape to cancel.
itin_dnd_over: Draggable item {id} was moved over droppable area {over}.
itin_dnd_over_none: Draggable item {id} is no longer over a droppable area.
itin_dnd_end: Draggable item {id} was dropped over droppable area {over}
itin_dnd_cancel: Dragging was cancelled. Draggable item {id} was dropped.
place_unverified: Not matched to a map place
place_note_discard_body: Your edits to this note will be lost.
place_tags_hint: Separate multiple tags with commas. The server will split them automatically.
place_location_hint: Paste coordinates or a Google Maps link, tap the map, or move the map and use its center.
place_location_required: Set a location: paste coordinates, use the map center, or tap the map.
place_location_err_out_of_range: Latitude must be between -90 and 90, longitude between -180 and 180.
place_location_err_short_link: Short links can't be read here. Paste it in the place search instead, or paste the coordinates.
place_location_err_no_coords: That link has no coordinates. Use a link to a place or dropped pin, or paste the coordinates.
place_location_err_unrecognized: Enter coordinates like 35.6812, 139.7671 or paste a Google Maps link.
place_preview_hint: Add it to see hours, phone and photos.
place_search_placeholder: Search places or paste a Google Maps link…
place_load_error: Couldn't load that place. Try another result.
place_show_on_map_error: Couldn't show that place on the map.
place_link_error: Couldn't read this Google Maps link — try searching the name, or add it manually.
map_empty_day_prev: No places on Day {n} yet · showing Day {prev}
map_empty_day_stay: No places on Day {n} yet · showing your stay
map_empty_day_trip: No places on Day {n} yet · showing the whole trip
map_no_located_places: No places with a location yet. Add one and it shows up here.
map_carousel_empty: No places with a location on this day.
map_poi_retry_body: Try again or search for it.
place_refresh_hint: Unsaved changes on this page will be lost.
place_refresh_not_found: Google no longer lists this place.
place_refresh_invalid: Google can't look up this place. Pick it again from search.
place_refresh_skipped: This place changed while updating. Try again.
place_refresh_limit: Daily Google update limit reached. Try again tomorrow.
place_refresh_unavailable: Couldn't reach Google. Try again later.
booking_empty_all_body: Add a stay or transport — once it has a date, it shows on your itinerary and map.
booking_empty_stay_body: Add a stay — once it has dates, it shows on your itinerary and map.
booking_empty_move_body: Add a flight, train, car or ferry — once it has a date, it shows on your itinerary.
booking_gap_night: No stay booked for the night of {date}
booking_delete_confirm_body: “{name}” will be deleted from your bookings.
stay_search_placeholder: Search for your stay or paste a Google Maps link…
stay_preview_empty: Dates appear here once you set check-in and check-out
stay_discard_body: You have unsaved changes to this stay. Discard them?
ride_code_placeholder: Type a code ({code}) or place name
ride_code_placeholder_generic: Type a code or place name
ride_preview_empty: Arrival appears once you set the destination and duration
ride_discard_body: You have unsaved changes to this transport booking. Discard them?
budget_export_title: Exports logged expenses only — booking costs are not included
budget_excluded_body: — this trip is tracked in {currency}, and amounts are never converted, so they stay out of the total.
budget_merge_suggest: “{expense}” ({amount}) looks like the same payment as {booking}
budget_cat_both_sources: Includes {bookings} from bookings and {logged} logged separately. If one of them is a booking payment, delete the logged copy so it counts once.
budget_recent_empty: Nothing counted toward this budget yet.
budget_travelers_hint: Used for per-person numbers. Leave blank to count trip members.
budget_relabel_body_one: {n} existing entry is recorded in {from}. Relabel it as {to} too — the numbers are {strong}. Unchecked, they stop counting toward the total.
budget_relabel_body_other: {n} existing entries are recorded in {from}. Relabel them as {to} too — the numbers are {strong}. Unchecked, they stop counting toward the total.
budget_relabel_none: No existing entries are recorded in {currency}, so nothing will be relabelled.
budget_err_forbidden: You do not have permission to change this trip.
budget_err_session: Your session expired. Sign in again to save this.
budget_err_currency: Currency must be a 3-letter code, e.g. USD
expense_bookings_note: Stay and transport costs entered on {link} already count toward this budget — no need to add them again.
expense_discard_body: You have unsaved changes to this expense. Discard them?
expense_delete_confirm_body: “{label}” will be deleted from your budget.
cal_no_start: Set a trip start date to see your itinerary days here.
cal_export_title: Download this trip as an .ics calendar file
notes_empty_list: No notes yet. Create one above.
notes_last_edited_enter: Last edited {when} · press Enter to save
notes_empty_body: Create a checklist or doc to get started.
settings_intro: Preferences that follow you across every trip. Trip name, dates, budget and collaborators live in each trip's own settings.
settings_preferences_body: These follow you across every trip. Works signed out too — the choice is stored in a cookie until you have an account.
settings_distances_hint: Applies to route legs and day summaries.
settings_appearance_deferred: The app is light for now. Dark mode ships with the design-system work.
settings_api_tokens_body: For scripts and agents acting as you over /api/v1.
settings_token_hint: Connect your own agent to build trips over the REST API. Create a token, then send it as {code}.
settings_token_signin_notice: Sign in to create or revoke your personal API tokens.
settings_copy_once: Copy this now — it won’t be shown again.
tripset_intro: Details, budget and collaborators for this trip. Your own preferences live in {link}.
tripset_details_body: The name and dates every other view reads from. Extending the dates adds itinerary days; the range cannot be shortened below the days you already have.
tripset_budget_body: The currency every cost is compared in, and what you are aiming to spend. Booking costs are derived from these.
tripset_people_body: Who can see and edit this trip. Email sending is offline — copy the invite link and send it yourself.
tripset_people_notice: Email send is offline for now — copy each invite link and send it yourself. A link is shown only once; use “New link” on a pending invite if you lose it.
tripset_invite_link_expired: Link expired — send a new one
tripset_invite_new_link_title: Issues a new link. Any link already sent for this invite stops working.
tripset_integrations_body: How this trip reaches your calendar and your scripts.
tripset_ics_body: Itinerary days and bookings. No reminders are included.
tripset_delete_body: Permanently deletes the itinerary, bookings, expenses and invites for everyone on it.
tripset_delete_note: Deleting asks you to confirm once, in the same dialog the rest of the app uses for destructive actions. Trips can also be deleted from the trips list on the home page.
tripset_dates_hint: Date changes keep the current itinerary length or expand it.
tripset_invite_copy_manual: Couldn’t reach the clipboard. The link above is selected — press ⌘C / Ctrl+C to copy it.
